name: Easily confused words
note: Pairs that learners mix up: make/do, say/tell, borrow/lend, bring/take, as/like, lie/lay, its/it's, been/gone. Check the exact pattern each one needs.

questions.q: His mother forced him to ______ his homework every night after supper.
questions.fs: His mother forced him to do his homework every night after supper.

questions.q: Tim's grandparents suffered ______ the Great Depression.
questions.fs: Tim's grandparents suffered through the Great Depression.

questions.q: His mother was late because she ______ the beds before she left the house.
questions.fs: His mother was late because she made the beds before she left the house.

questions.q: While the family was camping, they heard a loud growl in the bushes. They were afraid that it might be a bear because they were camping in ______ country.
questions.fs: While the family was camping, they heard a loud growl in the bushes. They were afraid that it might be a bear because they were camping in grizzly country.

questions.q: No one knows why he ______ those terrible things in the past.
questions.fs: No one knows why he did those terrible things in the past.

questions.q: We had a delicious picnic on the bank of the small ______ last weekend.
questions.fs: We had a delicious picnic on the bank of the small creek last weekend.

questions.q: His teacher begged him to ______ more of an effort in class.
questions.fs: His teacher begged him to make more of an effort in class.

questions.q: Every night after supper, Lawrence lies down on the sofa with a good book. Lawrence needs a magnifying glass to read because his ______ is so bad.
questions.fs: Every night after supper, Lawrence lies down on the sofa with a good book. Lawrence needs a magnifying glass to read because his sight is so bad.

questions.q: The business ______ a lot of money this year.
questions.fs: The business made a lot of money this year.

questions.q: The window latch broke earlier in the day. By nightfall, the wind was blowing harder than ever, and there was a noticeable ______ in the apartment.
questions.fs: The window latch broke earlier in the day. By nightfall, the wind was blowing harder than ever, and there was a noticeable draft in the apartment.

questions.q: The manager was surprised at how many things Ron could ______ at once.
questions.fs: The manager was surprised at how many things Ron could do at once.

questions.q: The teacher did not extend the essay's due date despite her students' ______
questions.fs: The teacher did not extend the essay's due date despite her students' pleas.

questions.q: The teacher suggested they ______ another exercise to understand the problem better.
questions.fs: The teacher suggested they do another exercise to understand the problem better.

questions.q: I can ______ the Pacific Ocean and many marine animals, such as seagulls and porpoises, from my bedroom window every day.
questions.fs: I can see the Pacific Ocean and many marine animals, such as seagulls and porpoises, from my bedroom window every day.

questions.q: The teacher had to ______ up a new syllabus because her old one was outdated.
questions.fs: The teacher had to make up a new syllabus because her old one was outdated.

questions.q: After retirement, the elderly couple decided it was time to ______ their large home and move into something smaller.
questions.fs: After retirement, the elderly couple decided it was time to sell their large home and move into something smaller.

questions.q: I'm not quite ready yet?? I have to ______ my hair.
questions.fs: I'm not quite ready yet?? I have to do my hair.

questions.q: Kevin was very tired and he ______ loudly when his teacher began reciting the play.
questions.fs: Kevin was very tired and he sighed loudly when his teacher began reciting the play.

questions.q: They ______ up quickly after their silly argument.
questions.fs: They made up quickly after their silly argument.

questions.q: Sharon normally takes her film to the nearby shop to get her negatives developed and ______ made.
questions.fs: Sharon normally takes her film to the nearby shop to get her negatives developed and prints made.

questions.q: No matter how hard she pushed him, she couldn't ______ her son do the job properly.
questions.fs: No matter how hard she pushed him, she couldn't make her son do the job properly.

questions.q: The bank across the street offered us a very good interest rate on a personal ______ this month.
questions.fs: The bank across the street offered us a very good interest rate on a personal loan this month.

questions.q: She ______ him a solemn promise that she would never steal again.
questions.fs: She made him a solemn promise that she would never steal again.

questions.q: ______ is used as a main ingredient in many baked products.
questions.fs: Flour is used as a main ingredient in many baked products.

questions.q: We only have one more pot of stew?? will it ______ ?
questions.fs: We only have one more pot of stew?? will it do?

questions.q: At the South Pole, ______ Emperor penguins stay with their female mates' eggs until their chick hatches. They endure long periods of cold and hunger during this time.
questions.fs: At the South Pole, male Emperor penguins stay with their female mates' eggs until their chick hatches. They endure long periods of cold and hunger during this time.

questions.q: He was confused and couldn't ______ up his mind about what to do next.
questions.fs: He was confused and couldn't make up his mind about what to do next.

questions.q: Johnny looked ______ and felt nauseous when he saw his father eat a raw oyster for the first time.
questions.fs: Johnny looked pale and felt nauseous when he saw his father eat a raw oyster for the first time.

questions.q: The university research team stumbled upon something; it ______ a really big discovery.
questions.fs: The university research team stumbled upon something; it made a really big discovery.

questions.q: After a year of continual turmoil, Kevin decided to move to a place with ______ political upheaval.
questions.fs: After a year of continual turmoil, Kevin decided to move to a place with less political upheaval.

questions.q: She suddenly realized that she only had a few days left on her vacation, so she decided to ______ the most of it.
questions.fs: She suddenly realized that she only had a few days left on her vacation, so she decided to make the most of it.

questions.q: The skating ______ performed very well in both the short and long programs.
questions.fs: The skating pair performed very well in both the short and long programs.

questions.q: She finally begged him to ______ a move in their very long and tiresome chess game.
questions.fs: She finally begged him to make a move in their very long and tiresome chess game.

questions.q: Shelley's ______ is very long. It almost touches the floor.
questions.fs: Shelley's hair is very long. It almost touches the floor.

questions.q: He was very proud of his car yesterday, because during the race it ______ 260 km/hr.
questions.fs: He was very proud of his car yesterday, because during the race it did 260 km/hr.

questions.q: Every year before Christmas, there are huge ______ on all kinds of Christmas wrapping paper, ornaments and decorations.
questions.fs: Every year before Christmas, there are huge sales on all kinds of Christmas wrapping paper, ornaments and decorations.

questions.q: Even though the situation was not ideal, they decided to ______ a go of things.
questions.fs: Even though the situation was not ideal, they decided to make a go of things.

questions.q: Josephine told her best friend Olivia to ______ the moment, so Olivia is going to Europe this summer.
questions.fs: Josephine told her best friend Olivia to seize the moment, so Olivia is going to Europe this summer.

questions.q: We had so much fun in Chicago?? we ______ it in three days.
questions.fs: We had so much fun in Chicago?? we did it in three days.

questions.q: Coffee is delicious. However, there are also many different kinds of delicious ______ to choose from these days.
questions.fs: Coffee is delicious. However, there are also many different kinds of delicious teas to choose from these days.

questions.q: The honeymooners rented the penthouse ______ at the gorgeous hotel with the stunning ocean-front views.
questions.fs: The honeymooners rented the penthouse suite at the gorgeous hotel with the stunning ocean-front views.

questions.q: I bought a small ______ of scented lavender oil yesterday.
questions.fs: I bought a small vial of scented lavender oil yesterday.

questions.q: Casey asked her mother to ______ her a mountain bike for her 14th birthday next month.
questions.fs: Casey asked her mother to buy her a mountain bike for her 14th birthday next month.

questions.q: On Saturday night, Clay and Cindy are going to a concert at the local auditorium. The new ______ received good reviews in the paper last week.
questions.fs: On Saturday night, Clay and Cindy are going to a concert at the local auditorium. The new band received good reviews in the paper last week.

questions.q: The cat chased his ______ until he fell over from dizziness.
questions.fs: The cat chased his tail until he fell over from dizziness.

questions.q: The ______ has a lot of difficult decisions to make including whether he should proceed with the raid tonight.
questions.fs: The colonel has a lot of difficult decisions to make including whether he should proceed with the raid tonight.

questions.q: Before you buy that used car, you should check with the Motor Vehicles Department to make sure the car is free of any ______
questions.fs: Before you buy that used car, you should check with the Motor Vehicles Department to make sure the car is free of any liens.

questions.q: The couple decided to go with the larger ______ because they are going to have about 250 guests attending their wedding reception in June.
questions.fs: The couple decided to go with the larger hall because they are going to have about 250 guests attending their wedding reception in June.

questions.q: The flight attendant walked up and down the ______ to make sure all of the passengers had enough to eat and drink on the long flight to Australia.
questions.fs: The flight attendant walked up and down the aisle to make sure all of the passengers had enough to eat and drink on the long flight to Australia.

questions.q: Joey asked his father to ______ him a bedtime story. His favorite book is 'Green Eggs and Ham' by Doctor Seuss.
questions.fs: Joey asked his father to read him a bedtime story. His favorite book is 'Green Eggs and Ham' by Doctor Seuss.

questions.q: First, Mandy said she wanted ______ pieces of candy, and then she asked for three.
questions.fs: First, Mandy said she wanted two pieces of candy, and then she asked for three.

questions.q: How much of an ______ did World War II have on Europe?
questions.fs: How much of an effect did World War II have on Europe?

questions.q: In Canada, there are many different types of wild animals, including large mammals such as ______
questions.fs: In Canada, there are many different types of wild animals, including large mammals such as moose.

questions.q: Thomas tried to give blood this past week, but the new nurse said she couldn't draw a sample. She was unable to find a suitable ______ in Thomas's arm.
questions.fs: Thomas tried to give blood this past week, but the new nurse said she couldn't draw a sample. She was unable to find a suitable vein in Thomas's arm.

questions.q: People should always make sure they dispose of their ______ products in an environmentally friendly way.
questions.fs: People should always make sure they dispose of their waste products in an environmentally friendly way.

questions.q: The eyewitness caught only a ______ glimpse of the armed robber. As a result, she couldn't identify the thief in a police lineup.
questions.fs: The eyewitness caught only a faint glimpse of the armed robber. As a result, she couldn't identify the thief in a police lineup.

questions.q: I think Kevin's heart is in the right place because we should always strive for world ______
questions.fs: I think Kevin's heart is in the right place because we should always strive for world peace.

questions.q: The garden was made up of a lot of high hedges in perfect rows. It looked like a ______ from above.
questions.fs: The garden was made up of a lot of high hedges in perfect rows. It looked like a maze from above.

questions.q: There are many ______ and unfortunate people in every country around the world.
questions.fs: There are many poor and unfortunate people in every country around the world.

questions.q: Tom is a talented and innovative carpenter. He uses many different types of ______ in his work.
questions.fs: Tom is a talented and innovative carpenter. He uses many different types of wood in his work.

questions.q: Katherine felt like doing something different, so she decided to pierce her ______ this week.
questions.fs: Katherine felt like doing something different, so she decided to pierce her navel this week.

questions.q: The raccoon ______ the little squirrel around the backyard for nearly 20 minutes.
questions.fs: The raccoon chased the little squirrel around the backyard for nearly 20 minutes.

questions.q: If you want to fight your speeding ticket, you must appear in traffic ______ to defend your position on the 15th of the month.
questions.fs: If you want to fight your speeding ticket, you must appear in traffic court to defend your position on the 15th of the month.

questions.q: Don't forget to ______ the window. There was a terrible draft in here when I came home yesterday.
questions.fs: Don't forget to close the window. There was a terrible draft in here when I came home yesterday.

questions.q: After the huge feast, Tim's stomach ached because he ______ so much delicious food at one time.
questions.fs: After the huge feast, Tim's stomach ached because he ate so much delicious food at one time.

questions.q: Children often like ______ and ketchup on their hotdogs.
questions.fs: Children often like mustard and ketchup on their hotdogs.

questions.q: There is a great deli around the corner. Tom orders corned beef on ______ bread for lunch every day.
questions.fs: There is a great deli around the corner. Tom orders corned beef on rye bread for lunch every day.

questions.q: Tyler ______ that the team was in trouble, so he tried harder than usual to strike out the batter.
questions.fs: Tyler knew that the team was in trouble, so he tried harder than usual to strike out the batter.

questions.q: At the ______ of the painting, beautiful colors were used to depict water.
questions.fs: At the base of the painting, beautiful colors were used to depict water.

questions.q: I have to buy a ______ because I want to grow a productive vegetable garden this spring.
questions.fs: I have to buy a spade because I want to grow a productive vegetable garden this spring.

questions.q: The ______ was long and looked like a ribbon laid out across the hills of the prairies.
questions.fs: The road was long and looked like a ribbon laid out across the hills of the prairies.

questions.q: A single ______ fell from her eyes when she heard about the fire.
questions.fs: A single tear fell from her eyes when she heard about the fire.

questions.q: If you want to make southern fried chicken, you should use a deep ______ because you will need a lot of peanut oil.
questions.fs: If you want to make southern fried chicken, you should use a deep fryer because you will need a lot of peanut oil.

questions.q: You will need a passport if you want to cross the ______ They just changed the law this year.
questions.fs: You will need a passport if you want to cross the border. They just changed the law this year.

questions.q: Kathy bought a beautiful ______ to go with her gorgeous wedding dress.
questions.fs: Kathy bought a beautiful veil to go with her gorgeous wedding dress.

questions.q: Carson felt ______ and nauseous. He wondered if he'd gotten food poisoning from the seafood restaurant he'd dined in earlier in the evening.
questions.fs: Carson felt weak and nauseous. He wondered if he'd gotten food poisoning from the seafood restaurant he'd dined in earlier in the evening.

questions.q: Dorothy carefully ______ all of the Christmas gifts, and then she filled all of the stockings with small gifts and goodies.
questions.fs: Dorothy carefully wrapped all of the Christmas gifts, and then she filled all of the stockings with small gifts and goodies.

questions.q: Carrie was tired and soon became ______ with the activity her teacher had assigned.
questions.fs: Carrie was tired and soon became bored with the activity her teacher had assigned.

questions.q: During the boring play, Isaiah began to ______ off. His head fell onto his mother's shoulder.
questions.fs: During the boring play, Isaiah began to doze off. His head fell onto his mother's shoulder.

questions.q: George ______ her on her speech and she politely thanked him as she walked past the crowd of reporters.
questions.fs: George complimented her on her speech and she politely thanked him as she walked past the crowd of reporters.

questions.q: Parents are constantly reminding their children to eat ______ of their vegetables at supper time.
questions.fs: Parents are constantly reminding their children to eat all of their vegetables at supper time.

questions.q: At the ______ of the crime, police officers interviewed eyewitnesses and gathered evidence.
questions.fs: At the scene of the crime, police officers interviewed eyewitnesses and gathered evidence.

questions.q: The ______ factory produces much-needed products, but it also pollutes the air and water supply.
questions.fs: The steel factory produces much-needed products, but it also pollutes the air and water supply.

questions.q: There is a terrible ______ bug going around. Everyone at work is sick and the clinics are full of patients who want to get better before Christmas.
questions.fs: There is a terrible flu bug going around. Everyone at work is sick and the clinics are full of patients who want to get better before Christmas.

questions.q: Every December, the children pray for snow because they love going on ______ rides on Christmas Eve.
questions.fs: Every December, the children pray for snow because they love going on sleigh rides on Christmas Eve.

questions.q: ______ of canola fields in the prairies make the whole earth look like a golden blanket.
questions.fs: Rows of canola fields in the prairies make the whole earth look like a golden blanket.

questions.q: I asked my husband to ______ my purse while I put on my winter coat.
questions.fs: I asked my husband to hold my purse while I put on my winter coat.

questions.q: In the morning, Sally loves to eat organic ______ because it's made with oats. She feels that gives her a healthy start every day.
questions.fs: In the morning, Sally loves to eat organic cereal because it's made with oats. She feels that gives her a healthy start every day.

questions.q: The farmer often says that a peaceful, natural life is the only ______ for him.
questions.fs: The farmer often says that a peaceful, natural life is the only way for him.

questions.q: The ______ is large and has a Victorian flavor to it. We stayed there for two days.
questions.fs: The inn is large and has a Victorian flavor to it. We stayed there for two days.
